summary.intent: Resolve CodeRabbit PR review threads on cipher-box SDK (key zeroization and operation ordering fixes), then run a local CodeRabbit CLI review after the user exhausted their PR quota.
summary.outcome: All 3 original CodeRabbit threads resolved and fixed in signed commit fca0e6eff; CI E2E went fully green across all 3 desktop platforms; CLI review produced one finding (atomicity gap + missing failure-path tests) which was addressed by adding 4 new tests plus a deferred follow-up todo.

repo: cipher-box uses a release-bot that can rebase the branch between pushes; pushes must handle a rejected push by rebasing over the bot's commit.
The SDK has a clearBytes utility for zeroing key material in memory; it must be called in try/finally blocks, and never on shared folderTree references.

moveItem has a genuine atomicity gap: re-encrypt → publish dest → publish source means a dest-publish failure leaves metadata re-keyed to dest but pointer still in source, and neither ordering eliminates the unrecoverable-via-UI partial-failure window.

A full recovery/idempotency mechanism (making moveItem retry-safe, e.g. resolveFileMetadata falling back to dest key) is the correct fix for the atomicity gap and needs to cover restoreFromBin and the desktop path as well.
CodeRabbit CLI v0.6.0 is available locally; it accepts --agent for structured findings and can be scoped to a branch diff.

code.finding: addToBin: originalFolderKeyEncrypted (wrapKey) must be computed before updateFolderMetadataAndPublish to avoid split state on failure.
restoreFromBin: unwrapped key material (folderKey + file IPNS key) must be cleared in a try/finally with clearBytes; never clear the shared folderTree reference.
moveItem: fileIpnsPrivateKey must be cleared in a try/finally to cover the throw-before-updateFileMetadata path.

Suite extended with 4 failure-path tests pinning current behavior for re-encrypt failure, dest-publish failure, source-publish failure, and resolveFileMetadata failure; unwrapKey mock import required.
clearBytes must be added to the crypto mock to support the zeroization fixes in addToBin/restoreFromBin.

workflow: CodeRabbit CLI review (coderabbit review --agent) is a viable fallback when PR-quota is exhausted; takes a few minutes and returns structured findings.

When a real atomicity gap cannot be closed safely within the current PR scope, the correct response is: add failure-path tests that pin current behavior, document the gap explicitly, and file a scoped follow-up rather than shipping a half-fix.
Validating TS-internal changes (zeroization, ordering) with tsc --noEmit + affected unit suites is sufficient when the change has no E2E-observable behavior.

friction: User ran out of CodeRabbit PR review quota mid-session, requiring a fallback to the local CLI.
Release-bot rebase races on push require handling rejected pushes with a rebase loop.
open_items: Implement a recovery/idempotency mechanism for moveItem (and restoreFromBin + desktop) so partial failures are recoverable via UI retry — tracked in .planning/todos/pending/2026-06-17-move-restore-reencrypt-partial-failure-recovery.md.
Re-dispatch full CI E2E on the latest commit (fca0e6eff) was left as an open question — unit tests were deemed sufficient for the review-only changes, but not explicitly confirmed by the user.
